scope.input: US-position printable keys, with shifted ASCII representing Shift; not PDF codes
scope.keymagic: empty context, pinned Linux engine, modeled passthrough for an unhandled event
scope.mac: CLDR historical OS X 10.9 single-key table; no general Mac pair behavior inferred

event_status.P: unhandled, context unchanged; modeled host passthrough
event_status.U: unhandled after context changed; output uncertain
event_status.R: reported historical example, not native replay

scope.eligibility: Exclude U and artifacts with compiler/engine warnings from subset agreements; P remains a host model, L is static, R is reported.
scope.full_agreement: Exactly equal final text across every compared artifact, no missing member or diagnostic; no Unicode normalization.
scope.subset_agreement: At least two eligible artifact records with exactly the same key and output; not independent layouts or universal agreement.
limitations: Pair outputs are complete final contexts and can reorder or compose; singles cannot be concatenated to infer them.
Printable ASCII and selected longer witnesses do not exhaust KeyMagic modifier, mobile, switch or arbitrary-context behavior.
CLDR omissions and untested Mac pairs are missing, not empty outputs.
Zawgyi outputs and invisible code points are preserved exactly; no PDF byte, CID, GID or font-slot mapping is implied.
Keyboard source licenses vary; check sources.json before redistribution.
